title: Perform Operator Station Lockout/Tagout Using Visu_Dual_MCP and Electrical Panel Power Switch
summary: Safely stop the operator station for lockout/tagout by using the operator station HMI to navigate to the Visu_Dual_MCP screen, press CYCLE STOP, optionally jog the tipper carriages using the JOG controls (+/–) for the correct tipper axis, then turn OFF the operator station electrical panel power switch and apply LOTO.
when_to_use: Use when you need to place the operator station into a stopped state and then perform lockout/tagout at the operator station electrical panel.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Execute the operator station stop (CYCLE STOP), optionally jog carriages using the JOG controls, then turn the operator station electrical panel power switch to OFF and apply LOTO.
safety_notes: Risk of personal injury: Do not touch the tippers while the system is powered ON.
Risk of personal injury: Be aware of the movement trajectory of the product and do not interfere with the line.
Risk of personal injury: Ensure no one approaches or extends a hand into the lift connecting rod assembly before starting the robot when powered on.
access_or_tools_needed: Operator station electrical panel access (power switch and LOTO capability)

visual_references.description: Operator station main screen showing the CYCLE STOP button (Stopping the Operator Station).
Visu_Dual_MCP jogging screen showing Z1/Z2/A1/A2 axis controls and +/– buttons (Jogging the Tipper).
Visu_Dual_MCP screen reference used for manually referencing axes; includes instruction to press CYCLE STOP before jogging.
Visu_Dual_MCP screen reference for manually referencing axes; includes instruction to press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle.
Tipper Machine Control Panel (Visu_MCP_Dual) showing JOG and CYCLE STOP controls and note about active buttons.

steps.title: Navigate to the Visu_Dual_MCP screen on the operator station HMI
steps.purpose: Open the correct operator station HMI screen that provides CYCLE STOP and (if needed) JOG controls for the tipper carriages.
steps.instruction: At the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen.
steps.expected_result: The "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen is displayed on the operator station HMI.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen controls used for stopping and jogging (including CYCLE STOP).
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot reach the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 1. At the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen.

steps.title: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the operator station
steps.purpose: Stop the automatic tipping cycle at the operator station as the first step in preparing for LOTO.
steps.expected_result: The operator station is in a stopped state after pressing CYCLE STOP.
steps.healthy_condition: CYCLE STOP has been pressed and the automatic tipping cycle is halted (operator station is stopped).
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot press "CYCLE STOP".

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The procedure to stop the operator station is to press the CYCLE STOP button on this main screen.

steps.title: Optionally jog the carriages using JOG (+/–) for the correct tipper axis
steps.purpose: If needed, reposition the tipper carriages to a different position while the cycle is stopped, using the JOG controls for the correct axis.
steps.instruction: If you need to move the carriages to a different position: press "JOG", select the corresponding axis for the tipper, then use the "+" and "-" buttons to move the carriages.
steps.expected_result: The carriages move to the desired position using the selected tipper axis controls after pressing JOG.
steps.healthy_condition: You can select the corresponding tipper axis and the +/– jog controls move the carriages as intended.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot access the JOG controls or cannot move the carriages using the +/– buttons.

actions.label: Select tipper axis and jog
actions.exact_action: Select the corresponding axis for the tipper and use the + and – buttons to move the carriages.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 3. If you need to move the carriages to a different position, do the following: a. Press JOG. b. Select the corresponding axis for the tipper and use the + and – buttons to move the carriages.
Press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle. Press JOG to open the jogging screen... Select the axis you want to move and use the – and + buttons to move.

steps.title: Turn OFF the operator station electrical panel power switch and apply LOTO
steps.purpose: Complete lockout/tagout by removing power at the operator station electrical panel and applying LOTO.
steps.instruction: At the operator station electrical panel, turn the power switch to "OFF" and apply LOTO.
steps.expected_result: The operator station electrical panel power switch is set to "OFF" and LOTO is applied.
steps.healthy_condition: Power switch is in the OFF position and LOTO is applied at the operator station electrical panel.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot set the electrical panel power switch to "OFF" or LOTO cannot be applied.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the electrical panel power switch cannot be set to "OFF" or LOTO cannot be applied.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 4. At the operator station electrical panel, turn the power switch to "OFF" and LOTO.

success_criteria: Operator station is stopped after pressing CYCLE STOP.
Operator station electrical panel power switch is set to "OFF" and LOTO is applied.
healthy_conditions: Visu_Dual_MCP screen is accessible and CYCLE STOP can be pressed.
JOG controls are available for optional carriage repositioning (if needed).
Electrical panel power switch is OFF and LOTO is applied.
failure_conditions: Cannot set the operator station electrical panel power switch to "OFF".
escalation_guidance: If you cannot reach the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen or cannot press "CYCLE STOP", stop and escalate.
If you cannot set the electrical panel power switch to "OFF" or cannot apply LOTO, stop and escalate.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Operator station lockout/tagout steps: navigate to "Visu_Dual_MCP", press CYCLE STOP, optionally press JOG and use +/– on the corresponding tipper axis, then turn the operator station electrical panel power switch to "OFF" and apply LOTO.
Stopping the operator station: press the CYCLE STOP button on the operator station main screen.
Jogging the tipper: press CYCLE STOP, press JOG to open jogging screen, select axis and use – and + buttons to move.

missing_details: No explicit electrical panel power switch label text or LOTO point/lock location is provided in the packet evidence; only the instruction to turn the power switch to "OFF" and apply LOTO is supported.
